Mode: bayer: ordered dither. halftone: rotated dots. ascii: text glyphs chosen by brightness.
Cellsize: Cell height in render pixels (ASCII cells are half as wide). Resolution dependent.
Levels: Bayer mode: number of output levels. 2 = pure two-tone.
Angle: Halftone mode: dot-screen angle in degrees.
Glyphs: ASCII mode: up to 16 characters ordered dark to light.
Color1: Dark tone of the two-tone output.
Color2: Light tone of the two-tone output.
Contrast: Contrast of the shaded luminance around 0.5. 1 = unchanged.
Invert: Swap the dark and light mapping.
Ambient: Minimum ambient light so shadows are not fully dark.
Rim: Strength of the rim light at silhouette edges.
Spinlight: Whole revolutions the key light makes around Y per preview cycle. 0 = fixed Lightdir.
Lightdir: Key light direction in world space.
Modamount: Scales the modulation CHOP (in1). band1 adds contrast, band2 shrinks Cellsize. 0 = ignore.
Resolution: Preview only: size in pixels of the internal preview render.
Turns: Preview only: whole revolutions of the objects per animation cycle.
Camdistance: Preview only: camera distance in world units.
